metadata.title: feat: add experimental core-owned Rust auth service
metadata.author: lucarlig

description:
# ✨ Feature / Enhancement PR

## 🔗 Epic / Issue
_Link to the epic or parent issue:_
N/A

---

## 🚀 Summary (1-2 sentences)
This PR adds a standalone experimental Rust auth service as a core-owned auth SPI implementation, wires the Rust MCP runtime to consume it over gRPC on UDS, and enforces that mounted public Rust MCP traffic is authenticated in Rust rather than Python. It also adds parity-oriented tests, oracle fixtures, and benchmark scaffolding for direct and mounted auth comparisons.

---

## 🧪 Checks

- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated (if user-facing)

---

## 📓 Notes (optional)
### Direct auth-only benchmark

`CoreAuthUser`, `session_jwt`, `20 users`, `10/s spawn`, `10s`.

| Lane | Requests | Failures | RPS | Avg (ms) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Python core auth | 5132 | 0 | 569.55 | 30.02 |
| Rust auth sidecar | 50457 | 0 | 5604.57 | 0.29 |
| No-auth ceiling | 50718 | 0 | 5632.39 | 0.28 |

Rust auth stayed fully direct with zero proxy fallback on the measured lane. The estimated auth share of the Rust lane average latency is about `2.41%` relative to the no-auth ceiling.

### Mounted MCP auth-heavy benchmark

`MCPInitializeOnlyUser`, `30 users`, `10/s spawn`, `30s` with the no-auth ceiling always included.

| Lane | Requests | Failures | RPS | Avg (ms) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Python auth + Rust MCP | 3143 | 0 | 108.45 | 66.45 |
| Rust auth + Rust MCP | 3660 | 0 | 126.71 | 27.92 |
| No-auth ceiling + Rust MCP | 3673 | 0 | 126.49 | 27.33 |

Validation for the mounted Rust-auth lane:
- Rust auth `authenticate_requests` increased during the run
- Rust auth `proxied_auth_responses` stayed `0`
- Rust runtime `backend_auth_round_trips` increased during the run

The mounted Rust-auth lane is now close to the no-auth ceiling on this local initialize-only workload, with the remaining auth share estimated at about `2.1%` of the Rust-auth average latency.
